identity.name: CNA
identity.description: Singapore's international news channel and digital outlet, owned by Mediacorp, covering Asia-Pacific politics, business, society and global affairs.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Owned by Mediacorp, Singapore's state-owned media conglomerate. CNA operates with professional editorial standards but within Singapore's close media-government environment.

editorialOrientation.evidence: State-owned through Mediacorp, but CNA publishes a range of regional voices and critical analysis; structural caution and self-censorship risks remain.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: No MBFC rating parsed; self-assessed as centrist with a pro-establishment, technocratic Singaporean lens.
politicalLeaning.source: Analyst assessment from publisher self-description, secondary references and feed-level sample

economicPerspective.evidence: Business coverage is regionally focused and generally market-friendly, reflecting Singapore's trade and investment model.
economicPerspective.source: Analyst assessment from business and economic coverage

internationalAlignment.evidence: Singapore and ASEAN-centred coverage with a technocratic, pro-trade outlook.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: Professional broadcaster with named reporters and corrections; state ownership requires transparency but does not by itself invalidate reporting.
reliability.source: Analyst assessment from ownership, editorial record and feed-level sample

externalRatings.notes: No clean MBFC rating parsed for CNA.

intelligence.knownPerspective: Singapore-based regional coverage with a technocratic, pro-ASEAN lens. Strong on Southeast Asian business, policy and explainer journalism.

selectionRationale: Adds a Southeast Asian regional broadcaster with strong explainer and business coverage.

research.researchNotes: Official About page confirms Mediacorp ownership. State ownership and editorial independence are recorded separately; mapping to State Media is for compatibility. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
